plain_english: Om, hrim. O Kaumari, after performing worship beginning with the heart and offering sandal, unbroken rice, flowers, incense, lamp, food offerings, and so forth, a hymn is to be recited.
sanskrit_cite: oṃ hrī kaumārya hṛdayādipūjā candanākṣatapūspadhūpadipanaivedyādikaṃ datvā japya stotra

plain_english: For Tumburesvari, perform invocation and related acts beginning with the southeast and ending with the northeast; then perform water-offering worship. Om, invocation beginning with Anantaya and so forth.
sanskrit_cite: tuṃvureśvarīya āgnayādi īśānāntaṃ āvāhanādī tatosalapūjā oṃ ānaṃtāyatyādi āvāhanā
